distribution: unreleased source only; no package/version publication

management.principal: current authenticated Human owner or exact organization/group administrative source; never Developer or Agent
management.freshFactor: purpose-bound current TOTP for new mutations; status/inspect are read-only
management.identity: server-generated immutable GUID; operationId is separate and retained before submission
management.terminal: Uninstalled never reenabled; explicit reinstall/upgrade creates new installation identity
management.replay: exact same original actor/operation/intent; current state accompanies original immutable outcome; no new credentials
management.status: original mutation operationId + current original actor/scope; Unknown/recovery-required never Abort

installedConsent.exposure: foundational Human consent/policy workflows exercised through genuine canonical reference Probe contracts; full public Human issuance journey remains unaccepted
installedConsent.c1Compatibility: existing C1 ags1 authority remains independent and cannot be adopted as installed ags2 authority

execution.reconciliation: own committed read returns only nonsecret truth and keyed resultDigest, never private output replay

capacity.pruning: none; retain immutable histories and fail closed at capacity

versionProfile.ordering: strict SemVer core and prerelease numeric/lexical comparison; arbitrarily large numeric components within bounded input
versionProfile.upgrade: strictly greater approved current version and fresh identity
versionProfile.reinstall: same or greater current approved version; retained overlapping histories prevent rollback

sdk.otherFourEcosystems: raw contract only; no typed installation or installed Skill runtime acceptance

families.audit-troubleshooting: reviewed built-in bounded metadata adapter only
